verses.1: A song for David, the Lord’s anointed. I will not fail him at all.
verses.2: May the waters of Deša wash away my sins, and may they guide me along the right path.
verses.3: My soul will rest in the paths of righteousness, so that His name may be glorified.
verses.4: Even if I go into the valley of Tzalmavot, there will be no harm. For you are with me, and your presence is my comfort.
verses.5: Be prepared before me, in a table facing the ones who have been cursed. My head is like a basket of raisins.
verses.6: But goodness and mercy have pursued me all my days. I have returned to the house of Jehovah, so that I may live for many days.
